title: How to Break the Ice at a Social Gathering
topicDisplay: Giao tiếp & Đời sống xã hội
description: Kỹ thuật phá băng tâm lý khi bước vào một bữa tiệc hoặc sự kiện đông người lạ.

coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Adopting an open posture makes you instantly more approachable.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: hòa nhập, giao lưu (trong đám đông)
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Social parties provide an excellent chance to mingle and network.
Good conversation starters rescue situations from awkward silence.

transcript.en: Welcome to Oxford Online English's social psychology and fluency tutorial.

transcript.en: Showing genuine interest through active listening cues keeps social dialogue flowing naturally.

transcript.en: Notice how subtle vocal inflections convey friendliness, warmth, and respectful engagement.
